KgAnnotationDiff.description: One proposed property change, as it would be written.

before.description: The value before the write, or null when the property is new.

identity.description: The target's identity property value. Type depends on the label's identity property.

KgAnnotationDryRunResponse.description: A frozen annotation plan: what WOULD be written, with nothing written yet.

expiresAt.description: When the frozen plan lapses, ISO-8601. Echo it back verbatim.

planId.description: Pass this to /apply or /undo. Single-use and time-limited.

selected.description: How many nodes the statement selected.

KgAnnotationOutcomeResponse.description: The result of applying or undoing a frozen plan.

conflicted.description: Targets that still exist but moved since the plan froze. Skipped, not forced.

disappearedOrUnauthorized.description: Targets that could not be re-bound in scope: deleted, re-owned or re-labeled. Deliberately ONE bucket — separating them would leak whether another tenant's data exists.

KgAnnotationPostImage.description: One committed post-image, read back inside the write transaction.

auditId.description: Audit record id for this individual write.

KgAnswerAccepted.description: Acknowledgement that a parked run accepted the owner's choice.

state.description: The state the run moved to as a result.

KgBackgroundHandle.description: A handle to a run started in the background.

choices.description: The question a parked run poses to its owner. Absent while running.

state.description: RUNNING, or WAITING_INPUT when the run parked on `choices`.

KgBadChoiceResponse.description: A rejected run answer, listing the choices this endpoint accepts.

candidates.description: Stale nodes this tick picked up. 0 with an `error` means the decorator is unknown.

error.description: Why the tick could not complete, or null. Always present.

KgDecoratorInfo.description: A registered node decorator and the cadence it runs on.

batchSize.description: Most candidates one tick will process.

refreshAfter.description: How stale a node must be before it is a candidate again, or `never`.

stampProperty.description: The property stamped on a node once decorated — how staleness is judged.

targetLabels.description: Labels this decorator considers as candidates.

tickInterval.description: How often the scheduled tick fires, ISO-8601 duration.

KgErrorResponse.description: A refusal carrying only a human-readable reason.

error.description: What went wrong, in the terms the caller can act on.

KgGenerateResponse.description: Generated cypher and what the engine will do with it, without running it.

attempts.description: How many generate-validate rounds it took.

explain.description: What the engine will do when this runs. Best-effort; never fails the call.

valid.description: Whether the final attempt passed the strict preflight.

KgInFlightRun.description: A virtual-cypher run currently executing for the acting user.

startedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds at which the run started.

KgKillResponse.description: The outcome of a kill request.

killed.description: False when the run had already settled, or was never the caller's.

KgQueryResult.description: The outcome of a virtual-cypher query: rows, the cypher that produced them, and what it cost.

apiCallLog.description: The actual calls as `producer(keys)`, in order — fan-out is visible here.

apiCalls.description: External fetches the executor made. 0 means everything was cached or local.

cypher.description: The cypher that actually ran, after scope rewriting.

durationMs.description: Total: bridge-resolve plus materialize plus read.

error.description: Why the query failed, or null when it did not.

hint.description: What to try instead. Accompanies an empty result only.

llmCallLog.description: The actual LLM calls (kg-ask and agg-*), in order.

llmCalls.description: LLM calls: the generation plus any aggregate reductions.

question.description: The question asked, echoed back. Present only for `/ask`.

reason.description: Typed outcome when this was not a clean answer — UNBOUNDED, NOT_IN_GRAPH, MISSING_ATTRIBUTE, DISCONNECTED or INTERNAL_ERROR. Absent on a real answer, so a caller can tell 'cannot answer' from a genuine zero without reading the hint text.

KgRefreshViewResponse.description: Whether a materialised view's cache was recomputed.

refreshed.description: False for a regular or unknown view — nothing was recomputed.

KgReprojectResponse.description: How much of a user's stored propositions were re-projected into graph edges.

KgRunConflictResponse.description: The run was not awaiting input; its actual state travels with the refusal.

detail.description: Why it is in that state, when anything was recorded. Null otherwise.

state.description: The run's real state: RUNNING, COMPLETED, KILLED, FAILED, CANCELLED or EXPIRED.

KgRunRef.description: A watchable run handle. Its presence means the rows are 'not yet', not 'none'.

answer.description: Where to send the owner's pick for a parked run. Absent while running.

choices.description: The `{kind, question, options, context}` payload when parked.

kill.description: Where to stop the run. Absent when parked — nothing is executing to kill.

poll.description: Where to poll for state and, once settled, the result.

KgRunState.description: The state of a background run, with its result once it has settled.

choices.description: The question a parked run poses to its owner.

detail.description: Why the run ended as it did, when anything was recorded.

expiresAt.description: Epoch milliseconds at which a parked run lapses into EXPIRED.

KgSaveViewRejection.description: A view was refused: a bad name, an unrunnable body, or a name already taken.

violations.description: Preflight defects when the body names shapes the schema contradicts.

KgSchemaLabel.description: A node label and its sampled property shape.

exhaustive.description: True when every node carrying this label was inspected, so an absent property genuinely does not exist here. False means the sample was capped — evidence of what exists, and no evidence at all about what does not.

sampleCount.description: How many nodes were sampled when inferring the properties.

KgSchemaProperty.description: A property observed on nodes carrying a label.

sparse.description: True when the property was missing from a non-trivial fraction of the sample.

type.description: Inferred type tag: string, long, datetime, list<string>, any, …

KgSchemaRelationship.description: A (from, type, to) triple observed in the world subgraph.

KgSchemaResponse.description: Labels, their properties, and relationship triples reachable by the acting user.

refreshedAt.description: When the snapshot was taken, ISO-8601. Absent when there is no snapshot.

KgValidationResponse.description: The result of validating cypher against the schema without executing it.

message.description: A single human-readable summary, or null when there is nothing to say.

violations.description: What the schema contradicts, one entry per defect.

KgViewInvocationResponse.description: The runnable cypher for a saved view invoked with the given arguments.

cypher.description: Run this through `/execute`, so a view uses the same engine as any other query.

default.description: Used when an invocation omits this param. Absent = required on invocation.

description.description: What the argument means — rendered verbatim as the field's hint.

type.description: `string`, `int`, `number` or `boolean` — the coercion applied to supplied values.
